card.name: Figure out / work out phrases
card.fires_on: The verb "figure" (or "figuring") and the particle "out" after "work" in phrases meaning to solve or determine something. It appears in general web prose, before a how/why/which clause or object.

modes.label: figure out
modes.description: The word "figure" or "figuring" right before "out", introducing something to be solved.
modes.example: We'll<< figure>> out the sensible size.

modes.label: work out
modes.description: The word "out" right after "work", "worked" or "works", meaning to devise or settle something.
modes.example: Adults are still trying to work<< out>> the appropriate rules for themselves

card.plain: It marks the phrase "figure out" or "work out", where someone is trying to solve or determine something.
